newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-KIRSTEN AND CULLINAN GIVE SOUTH AFRICA HUGE LEAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-KIRSTEN AND CULLINAN GIVE SOUTH AFRICA HUGE LEAD.

text.p: Centuries by Gary Kirsten and Daryll Cullinan boosted South Africa to 257 for two, a commanding lead of 356, on the fourth day of the second test against India on Saturday.
The pair added 212 before Kirsten was run out for 133 as he tried to steal a quick single. He batted 315 minutes for his third test century and hit 18 fours.
Cullinan, 101 not out at lunch, completed his second test century with a a cheeky single off leg-spinner Anil Kumble. His 100 included 13 fours and was completed in 253 minutes.
